def: The public, checkable result an artifact must reach before it counts as finished, such as a hacking rate measured before and after hardening.
Artifact 3: a library of typed, attested tool results, hidden splits and end-to-end timing, with hacking rate as a first-class metric.
An open-source suite of 250 PyTorch workloads that tests whether models write GPU kernels that are both correct and fast.
A research area that asks how to get useful work from a model while assuming it may be trying to undermine the safeguards.
The share of an agent's attempts that raised the score by exploiting the evaluator instead of solving the task.
An open-source framework that uses language models as mutation operators in evolutionary code search.
